content.title: WEEKLY GROCERY {{SHOWDOWN}}: WHO ACTUALLY WINS ON NUTRIENTS
facts: **Papaya** has more vitamin C than an **orange**, gram for gram, even though the orange gets all the credit.
**Pumpkin seeds** contain over ten times more **magnesium** than **broccoli** per 100 grams.
**Black beans** pack more than twenty times the **fiber** of the same amount of **white rice**.
**Mushrooms** exposed to sunlight can contain measurable **vitamin D** — something **carrots** essentially never provide.
**Dried apricots** have far more **iron** than fresh **apples**, nearly twenty times as much.
**Chickpeas** offer roughly five times more **zinc** than **potatoes** of the same weight.
**Walnuts** contain dramatically more plant-based **omega-3s** than **pistachios** — over thirty times more.
**Dried figs** have more than ten times the **fiber** of fresh **grapes**.
**Brussels sprouts** contain more than thirty times the **vitamin C** of **iceberg lettuce**.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
None of this means the 'lower' food is bad for you — every fruit and veggie brings something different to the table, and your body's needs can shift depending on the day, your activity level, or what else you're eating. Numbers are a guide, not a verdict.
